segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had you at 38 seats for the customer portal team, starting September 16, with billing to the Denver office. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly. We added two supervisors, so call it 40 seats. Same billing address, but the PO has to show cost center 7412 or accounts payable kicks it back.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 40 seats and cost center 7412 on the invoice. At the annual rate, that is $31,200 for the year, plus the one-time onboarding package at $4,800. No usage overage unless you go past 60,000 records a month.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We are usually around 42,000 records, so that is fine. Can we do net 30 instead of paying by card?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 30 is included on annual contracts over $25,000, so that works. First invoice would go out on September 16 and be due October 16.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. The other thing is go-live. Our VP wants the first group using it by October 7. Is that realistic?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, for 40 seats it is. The standard plan would be kickoff September 18, data load by September 25, admin training October 1, and end-user training October 3. Then you are live Monday, October 7.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That lines up. We need single sign-on turned on before training, though. Our IT lead is Mateo Chen.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect, I will list Mateo as the technical contact and include SSO setup in the implementation notes. He will get the setup checklist with the kickoff invite.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send me the order form today if you can. I can sign once procurement checks the tax line.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can send it by 3:00 Central today. It will show 40 seats, $36,000 total first-year amount before tax, net 30, September 16 start, and the October 7 target go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches. Send it over and copy procurement@ourdomain.com, please.
